title: Number to words
hints: Split the problem: `n / 1000` and `n % 1000` are both in `0..999`. If you can spell `1..999`, you can spell everything — `"<thousands words> thousand <rest words>"`, leaving out empty parts. Handle `0` and the range check up front.
Two lookup tables cover all the irregular words: `small := []string{"zero", "one", ..., "nineteen"}` (20 entries) and `tens := []string{"", "", "twenty", "thirty", ..., "ninety"}`.

In `spell999(n)`: hundreds is `n / 100` → `small[h] + " hundred"`; then for `r := n % 100` use a `switch`: `r < 20` → `small[r]`; `r%10 == 0` → `tens[r/10]`; otherwise `tens[r/10] + "-" + small[r%10]`. Only add a space between two non-empty parts.
